post.text:
The 2026 Commonwealth Games are on now in Glasgow. 
The 1974 Games took place here in Ōtautahi Christchurch. Check out our page for info & interviews & fab photos. 
my.christchurchcitylibraries.com/xth-commonwe... 
We didn't have a TARDIS at the opening ceremony, but we did have PIGEONS. 🥇^DR
